fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: A finishing thrust that deals 20 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.6 times their remaining damage. It only strikes a target at or below 30% health, a threshold that rises with each rank.

fusions.name: Follow the Trail
fusions.desc: A throw that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full range, and leaves the target [Marked] for 6 seconds. Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Quarry in Sight
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: No Ground to Hide
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them.
